introduction: Structured around hands-on engineering depth across Computer Vision, Edge AI, Generative AI, MLOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and Cloud Security. Prioritizing verifiable production skills over arbitrary percentages.

categories.title: Computer Vision & Object Detection
bullets: Custom YOLO fine-tuning on 10k annotated images, boosting mAP@0.5 to ~91%.
Multi-class object & attribute detection, pose, PPE, and carried objects.
Domain-specific data augmentation for harsh, variable lighting conditions.

categories.title: Generative AI & Vector Embeddings
bullets: LLM-based continuous event summarization and RAG search over CCTV records.
512-dimensional facial embedding extraction and cosine distance verification.
PostgreSQL with pgvector using HNSW indexing for sub-15ms vector queries.

categories.title: Edge AI & GPU Infrastructure
bullets: Hardware-accelerated decode/encode (nvv4l2decoder, nvv4l2h264enc) at 35–45 FPS.
Local dual-GPU server (2× RTX 5090, 64GB RAM) for 100+ FPS rapid benchmarking.
Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning of vision-language models for edge deployment.

categories.title: Cloud ML Services & MLOps
bullets: Custom Docker containers for real-time model inference on SageMaker ml.g5.
Automated CI/CD retraining workflows using AWS CodePipeline and Step Functions.
Model drift detection, endpoint health checks, and latency telemetry in CloudWatch.

categories.title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
bullets: Modular Terraform codebase managing multi-tenant production AWS infrastructure.
Auto-scaling ECS Fargate clusters and serverless Lambda microservices.
Infrastructure automation resulting in a 40% reduction in cloud operating costs.

categories.title: Cloud Security & Compliance
bullets: Zero-trust SSH tunneling via SSM ProxyCommand, closing all public SSH ports.
Customer-managed key (CMK) envelope encryption across S3, EBS, and Aurora RDS.
AWS Config rules, CloudTrail immutable auditing, and 80% security benchmark score.

categories.title: Programming & Frameworks
bullets: High-performance Python for computer vision pipelines and ML training loops.
Complex SQL schema design, pgvector indexing, and query optimization.
Production shell scripting for edge deployment automation and CI/CD steps.

categories.title: CI/CD & Observability
bullets: Continuous integration and delivery pipelines for Dockerized ML containers.
Real-time CloudWatch alarms with SNS notifications for inference latency spikes.
Automated blue-green canary deployment workflows for zero-downtime updates.
